scenario: Frozen TS-CORE-01 synthetic evidence is reviewed across the round-two Web and browser-extension packages, account-scoped localhost backend, iOS client, and installed Codex plugin without live candidate data or external writes.

review_plan.reason: Evaluate evidence boundaries, uncertainty, job relevance, and prohibited person scoring.
Evaluate dignity, restraint, transparency, and respectful candidate-evidence handling.
Evaluate current iOS task completion, accessibility evidence, backend parity, and recovery.
Evaluate recruiter decision clarity, recovery, duplicated work, and first-use comprehension.
Evaluate capture permissions, provenance, account scope, authorization, retention, deletion, and outcome truth.

reviews.lens: job-relevant evidence boundaries, calibrated uncertainty, prohibited person scoring, and separation of workflow attention from selection judgment
strengths: The frozen TS-CORE-01 object contains source-bound workflow facts and a recruiter-owned question proposal, not a candidate score, rank, personality inference, culture-fit label, or acceptance probability.
All eight core fixtures and the 13 backend failure boundaries preserve ambiguity, reject prohibited scoring, and keep proposed interpretation separate from confirmed state.
The repository plugin and the installed cache copy both pass 8/8 fixtures plus the three identity, authorization, and speaker probes with no execution authority.
The Web, iOS, browser-extension, backend, and plugin evidence all preserve the same proposal-only selection boundary.

reviews.lens: human-first handling of candidate evidence, respectful interpretation, transparency, restraint, and reversible recruiter action

findings.observation: The reviewed surfaces label the source as synthetic, preserve exact evidence, and require a separate Submit, but this run still has no user Google Chrome recording of the toolbar or selected-text gesture and temporary activeTab grant.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/round-2/final/chrome-manual-gap.json records the absent visible chrome://extensions, toolbar, and positive activeTab evidence; docs/evaluations/round-2/browser-extension/01-core-review-390.png shows only the reviewed extension package state.
findings.user_impact: The downstream workflow is restrained, but the run cannot prove that a candidate conversation enters it only through the promised deliberate recruiter gesture.
findings.recommendation: Repeat the exact package digest in a policy-authorized user Google Chrome profile and keep the exact selected evidence visible until explicit Submit.
findings.verification: A direct recording shows a synthetic source, visible toolbar or selected-text invocation, exact evidence preview, explicit Submit, and no earlier transfer.

strengths: The system records evidence-backed situational facts and never ranks candidate worth, personality, protected traits, culture fit, or acceptance probability.
Exact evidence, proposed facts, recruiter decisions, action authority, and observed outcome remain visibly distinct.
No candidate contact, calendar, message, ATS, CRM, or other external write was attempted.
No-action and ambiguity fixtures prevent manufactured urgency and unsupported interpretation.
missing_evidence: Direct user Google Chrome capture-permission and review recording.
Candidate-facing notice, consent, and retention policy evaluation remains outside this synthetic recruiter-only slice.
open_questions: What notice and deletion route will a live product expose before any real conversation can be submitted?

reviews.lens: iOS task completion, touch and accessibility layout, state semantics, backend parity, and failure recovery

findings.observation: The isolated iPhone 17 Simulator run passed 13 unit tests and 12 UI tests, including localhost fixture fetches, but no current VoiceOver traversal proves spoken labels, order, values, and state changes.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/round-2/final/command-results.json records the unit and UI xcresult summaries and the two successful localhost fixture requests; docs/evaluations/overnight/final/ios-review-sequence.json contains the prior AX5 dark-mode surface sequence.
findings.user_impact: Touch and large-text paths have direct evidence while a VoiceOver user may still encounter an unlabeled or confusing confirmation and outcome sequence.
findings.recommendation: Record a VoiceOver traversal of source evidence, each fact decision, action preview, and local outcome against the same frozen fixture.
findings.verification: VoiceOver announces identity, provenance, proposed versus confirmed state, exact target and effect, no-external-change result, and retry in logical order without duplicate or ambiguous controls.

strengths: The iOS project passed 13 unit tests and 12 UI tests in separate DerivedData directories with zero failures or skips.
The UI run fetched the frozen localhost fixture twice from 127.0.0.1:8787 and exercised the same synthetic evidence boundary.
A separate Release simulator build completed successfully with code signing disabled.
Prior direct AX5, dark-mode, ambiguity, no-action, prohibited-scoring, offline, and recovery evidence remains tied to the unchanged iOS implementation.
missing_evidence: A current VoiceOver spoken-order and control-state transcript.
open_questions: Does the same decision order remain efficient on the smallest supported iPhone rather than only the iPhone 17 simulator?

reviews.lens: time-constrained recruiter task completion, decision clarity, safe recovery, and inspectable outcomes

findings.observation: The authenticated Web and extension evidence directly cover proposed, confirmed, approved, verified, failure, stale, deletion, and recovery states, but no uncoached recruiter completed and explained the whole cross-surface sequence.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/round-2/web/browser/journey-trace.json and docs/evaluations/round-2/browser-extension/verification-summary.json cover the deterministic surface states; neither contains an uncoached participant session.
findings.user_impact: The workflow is executable, but the evidence does not prove that a first-time recruiter will correctly distinguish capture receipt, fact confirmation, action approval, and verified outcome without help.
findings.recommendation: Run one uncoached recruiter walkthrough across the visible Chrome capture, Web review, and verified readback.
findings.verification: A first-time recruiter completes TS-CORE-01 without prompting and correctly explains receipt, confirmation, approval, execution, and readback.

strengths: The Web round-two evidence directly covers the authenticated 390 px and 1440 px paths, keyboard focus, reduced motion, deletion, stale approval, unknown result, reconciliation, and capability revocation.
The real localhost handoff returned one account-scoped receipt; the duplicate request reused the same capture, receipt, and proposal rather than creating extra work.
The backend kept fact decisions, action approval, effect attempt, and destination readback distinct across two clients.
The extension and Web interfaces preserve exact evidence near the decision while exposing no candidate ranking or automated contact.
missing_evidence: An uncoached first-use cross-surface recruiter recording.
A field timing comparison against the recruiter's current manual workflow.
open_questions: Would recruiters prefer the four same-source fact decisions as one explicit batch decision after inspecting every fact?

reviews.lens: intentional capture, provenance, identity and account scope, authorization, retention, deletion, and truthful outcome claims

findings.observation: The exact MV3 package and localhost transport pass deterministic checks, but this run did not load and invoke the package through the user's visible Google Chrome toolbar or selected-text gesture and did not observe a positive temporary activeTab grant.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/round-2/final/chrome-manual-gap.json records the unresolved chrome://extensions, toolbar, positive activeTab, pre-Submit silence, and extension-originated receipt requirements for package sha256 4491ed23a7d236cb055987432a19309534594170b019f89dfb3f5e3aa2d8c416.
findings.user_impact: Candidate conversation evidence could be collected outside the promised visible, user-scoped capture boundary without this evaluation detecting it.
findings.recommendation: Repeat TS-CORE-01 in a policy-authorized user Google Chrome profile with the exact package digest, visible invocation, exact preview, and network trace.
findings.verification: One direct recording and trace show no background-tab or history access, no capture POST before Submit, one explicit Submit, and one account-scoped synthetic receipt.

findings.observation: The extension submitted retention_mode=ephemeral, but the Web adapter accepted the request and created the localhost capture with retention_until=null; deletion occurred only after a separate explicit deletion call.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/round-2/final/localhost-lifecycle.json records request round2-final-f3fe-001, receipt 0c500a45-16c8-4d81-8798-15ede78e1b14, source locator browser-extension-request:round2-final-f3fe-001, retention_until=null, and the later deletion 247d5830-37af-4c9b-b052-7b1242a2fd7c; apps/web/lib/server/localBackend.ts hard-codes retention_until:null rather than mapping retention_mode.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter can request ephemeral handling while the submitted conversation remains retained until another deletion action, contrary to the disclosed control.
findings.recommendation: Map every retention mode to an enforceable backend lifecycle, reject unsupported modes, and expose the effective policy in the receipt and readback.
findings.verification: For each mode, the same-account receipt reports the effective lifecycle; ephemeral source content becomes inaccessible after review without a second manual delete, derived lineage is inspectable, and retries cannot restore it.

strengths: The frozen localhost run used synthetic evidence only and performed zero candidate contact, calendar, message, ATS, CRM, or other external writes.
The backend passed all eight fixtures, 13 failure boundaries, duplicate idempotency, cross-account isolation, timeout reconciliation, revocation, and deletion lineage.
Receipt, proposed assertions, confirmed state, action approval, effect attempt, and destination readback remain distinct account-scoped records.
The explicit deletion call removed seven derivatives, revoked capture access, and made the prior receipt unreadable with a 404.
missing_evidence: Direct visible user Google Chrome load, invocation, positive activeTab grant, and pre-Submit network-silence trace.
Executable automatic-retention proof for ephemeral, evidence_crop, and full_source modes.
vetoes: XS-CAPTURE-01: the intentional user Google Chrome capture and pre-Submit silence boundary is unproven.
XS-RETENTION-01: the accepted ephemeral retention request is not enforced by the localhost handoff.
open_questions: What exact review-completion event should start the ephemeral disposal deadline?

top_findings.reason: The exact package was not loaded and positively invoked through the user's visible Google Chrome toolbar or selected-text surface, so temporary activeTab scope and pre-Submit silence remain unproven.
top_findings.next_step: Run the exact package digest in a policy-authorized user Google Chrome profile and record the complete permission-to-receipt trace.
top_findings.verification: A direct trace proves visible load, temporary activeTab, exact preview, no pre-Submit request, one explicit Submit, and one scoped synthetic receipt.

top_findings.reason: The localhost adapter accepted retention_mode=ephemeral while persisting the capture with retention_until=null until a separate deletion request.
top_findings.next_step: Implement enforceable retention mapping, reject unsupported modes, and surface the effective lifecycle in receipt and readback.
top_findings.verification: The ephemeral source becomes inaccessible after review without a second delete, derived lineage remains inspectable, and retries cannot restore it.

top_findings.reason: The deterministic flows are direct, but no uncoached recruiter or current VoiceOver traversal proves comprehension of every authority transition.
top_findings.next_step: Run one uncoached cross-surface walkthrough and one VoiceOver traversal on the frozen fixture.
top_findings.verification: The participant completes the flow without prompts and correctly explains receipt, confirmation, approval, execution, readback, and deletion; VoiceOver announces the same order.

agreements: All evaluated content is synthetic and localhost-bound; no candidate contact, calendar, message, ATS, CRM, or other external write occurred.
Evidence, proposed interpretation, confirmed state, action authority, effect attempt, and observed outcome remain distinct.
The eight fixtures, 13 backend boundaries, seven recovery checks, Web states, iOS tests, extension tests, and plugin probes preserve identity, ambiguity, no-action, and prohibited-scoring boundaries.
Duplicate handoff and effect attempts reused their original identifiers rather than creating duplicate work.
Web and extension craft scores remain attached to their own direct evidence and do not override the integrated safety gate.

veto_resolution.veto: XS-CAPTURE-01: the intentional user Google Chrome capture and pre-Submit silence boundary is unproven.
XS-RETENTION-01: the accepted ephemeral retention request is not enforced by the localhost handoff.

adjudication.rationale: The four accepted commits integrate cleanly and the frozen TS-CORE-01 checks establish strong deterministic evidence across Web, backend, iOS, extension, and installed plugin surfaces. Those results do not resolve the missing user Google Chrome permission boundary. The real localhost lifecycle additionally demonstrates that the accepted ephemeral request is persisted without a retention deadline until a separate deletion call. Both conditions fall within evidence-safety jurisdiction and are active vetoes. Per veto-first adjudication, neither the Web and extension 95–99 craft dimensions nor any specialist score can be averaged into a passing integrated verdict.

next_tests.test: Load and invoke the exact frozen MV3 digest in a policy-authorized user Google Chrome profile.
next_tests.evidence_required: Visible chrome://extensions state, toolbar or selected-text gesture, positive activeTab, exact preview, pre-Submit network log, Submit, and account-scoped receipt.
next_tests.pass_condition: XS-CAPTURE-01 is resolved with one synthetic receipt and no access to other tabs, history, cookies, or pre-Submit transfer.

next_tests.test: Exercise ephemeral, evidence_crop, and full_source retention through the real localhost handoff.
next_tests.evidence_required: Request, receipt-effective policy, lifecycle timestamps, post-review access checks, derived lineage, retry, and deletion readback for each mode.
next_tests.pass_condition: XS-RETENTION-01 is resolved: each accepted mode is enforced, unsupported modes fail closed, and ephemeral content cannot be read after review.

next_tests.test: Run one uncoached recruiter journey and one VoiceOver traversal on the same frozen fixture.
next_tests.evidence_required: Task recording, participant explanation, hesitation log, VoiceOver transcript, and final readback.
next_tests.pass_condition: The recruiter completes without prompting and correctly explains every authority state; assistive output preserves the same sequence.
